Maya (People Ops): Quick one 505 5 traveling to London next month with an invited external speaker. Can we cover the speaker's registration and their flight + hotel? Also, what about expensing my accompanying partner for dinners?
Sam (Finance): Short answer: employee expenses = reimbursable per policy. Guest/spouse = NOT reimbursable unless contractually required or pre-approved by legal + finance. Speaker/vendor: yes, but follow vendor payment flow (invoice + PO or vendor onboarding).
Maya (People Ops): Got it. Who initiates vendor onboarding / PO?
Leo (Manager): I already told Legal we needed the speaker contract. Do I need to do anything for travel booking?
Priya (Travel Ops): If speaker travel is company-paid, Travel Ops should book on the company card or issue a PO. Please send speaker contact + approved contract to travel-ops@redwood.company. We'll route through procurement if vendor needs payment.
Sam (Finance): For reimbursements to employees for paying speaker costs: do NOT put guest on your expense. Instead, create a vendor expense with invoice or route payment via procurement. 
Maya (People Ops): And about my partner0 s dinners: I paid one group dinner and covered two additional personal dinners. Can I put the whole restaurant bill on my expense and mark personal lines?
Sam (Finance): You can split the bill, but personal portions are not reimbursable. Required: itemized receipt showing line items and a short note splitting amounts + attendee list. If you can't split on the merchant folio, submit the full receipt and add a note with the personal amount; manager must approve.
Maya (People Ops): Ugh lost a taxi receipt cash in London 505. What's the lost-receipt process?
Sam (Finance): For lost receipts: submit a Lost Receipt Affidavit (PDF) with date, merchant, amount, reason for missing receipt, and manager approval signature. There's a per-item cap for taxi/ride-share reimb without receipt ($30) but check policy.
Priya (Travel Ops): If you paid by card, we can use the card statement + ride-share trip confirmation as backup. If truly cash, affidavit + manager sign-off.
Maya (People Ops): What about airfare upgrades? I booked premium economy because no coach seats on my preferred flight. Is that ok?
Sam (Finance): Upgrades require prior manager approval and a valid business justification in notes. No retroactive upgrades without explicit sign-off. If upgrade is personal (choice), the employee covers the difference and only the coach fare is reimbursed.
Leo (Manager): I pre-approved Maya's upgrade due to schedule constraints 505 noted in email thread. How to attach that?
ExpenseBot: Please attach the manager approval email as PDF to the expense and include a note: "Manager approval for upgrade on 2026-06-02, subject: conference travel".
Maya (People Ops): For the speaker hotel, do taxes and city fees get paid?
Priya (Travel Ops): Yes, taxes/mandatory city fees for company-paid travel are reimbursable. Optional extras (mini-bar, in-room movies) are personal and not reimbursable unless pre-approved.
Sam (Finance): Also: per-diem only applies to employee meals. If an employee elects per-diem, they don't submit meal receipts. If they submit actuals instead, all itemized receipts required.
Maya (People Ops): Last Q: timing. Speaker invoice + travel requested now; how long till payment?
Sam (Finance): Vendor onboarding + PO can take 7-14 business days if new vendor. If urgent, mark as expedited in procurement request and attach contract + speaker CV. For employee reimbursements, expect 5-10 business days after submission (if complete).
Maya (People Ops): Cool. Example note block for the expense?
Priya (Travel Ops): Paste this into the expense notes:

```
Speaker travel: Jane Doe (Speaker) - contract ID CN-2026-045
Air: 2026-06-10 LHR -> SFO (booked by Travel Ops, PO# PO-98765)
Hotel: 2026-06-10 to 2026-06-12 - taxes included
Manager approval: Leo email 2026-06-02 attached
Personal split: restaurant bill 2026-06-11 - personal portion $42.00 (not claimed)
Lost receipt: taxi 2026-06-11 - Lost Receipt Affidavit attached
```
Sam (Finance): Policy link: https://redwood.company/policies/travel-expense (see sections: vendor payments, lost receipts, upgrades). Tag me if you need manual review. :white_check_mark:
Maya (People Ops): Thanks all 505 will send docs to travel-ops and procurement.
Leo (Manager): Thanks 505 appreciated.
